origin.details: A hyphen is missing. Names are X1 onward because the file has no header.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- read_log(readr_example("example.log"), n_max = 1)
paste(paste(names(parsed), collapse = ","), flatv(parsed[[1]]), yn(is.na(parsed[[2]])), as.character(parsed[[3]]), flatv(parsed[[6]]), flatv(parsed[[7]]), sep = "|")

translation.details: A hyphen is missing. Names are X1 onward because the file has no header.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
parsed = read_log(readr_example("example.log"), n_max=1, show_col_types=False)
return ",".join(parsed.names) + "|" + flatv(parsed.columns[0]) + "|" + yn(parsed.columns[1][0] is None) + "|" + str(parsed.columns[2][0]) + "|" + flatv(parsed.columns[5]) + "|" + flatv(parsed.columns[6])
